description: "Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to summon a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for 8 seconds that deals 1151 Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every 0.5 seconds. \n\nThe scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain."
